ops.text: Customer (the Company) may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon 90 days' written notice to HDI. HDI may terminate this Agreement for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term and upon 90 days' written notice to Customer.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed the fees payable under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made Customer's convenience termination express on 90 days' written notice and limited HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice, and we capped the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees instead of an uncapped share of trailing Net Sales. This is our fallback position on termination for convenience.
proposal.summary: Add an express 90-day Customer convenience right, limit HDI's convenience exit to end of term on 90 days' notice, and cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees.

mappings.element: Early-termination fee not exceeding 3 months' fees.
